description: OpenHealth gets one hospice's Medicare record by its six-character CCN. The record includes Medicare's family caregiver survey star rating and answers, and every published quality measure with its denominator, percentile and period, including the Hospice Care Index. Values are as CMS publishes them. A blank stays null.

ccn.description: The agency's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 367128.

name: get_hospice
title: Get a hospice's Medicare record
